page.title: Learn
page.intro: Short explanations of inherited screening ideas. These topics are general education.
page.notAdvice: This page is not personal medical advice and it does not replace a qualified genetic counsellor.
page.informedChoicesLink: Explore informed choices and reflection prompts (public guide)

education.title: General education
education.body: These modules explain ideas that many people meet in carrier screening. They are not written about you.

personal.title: Personal medical advice
personal.body: Advice about your own result belongs with a qualified clinician. This page does not give that advice.

counsellor.title: A qualified counsellor
counsellor.body: A genetic counsellor can review a result, explain limits, and discuss options. Care is the path to a person.
